blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Health authorities in Romblon urged residents to strengthen preventive measures against infectious diseases after the province recorded 793 dengue cases, including seven deaths, from January to October 2026. Data from the Romblon Provincial Epidemiology and Surveillance Unit (PESU), covering morbidity weeks 1 to 44, showed that 786 dengue patients recovered while seven died. READ: Dengue, leptospirosis cases decline in latest DOH report San Fernando recorded the highest number of infections with 238 cases, followed by Cajidiocan with 198.
